Curt is a pilot. This means he must fly planes for work. He sports a white shirt and a necktie when he is on the plane. He has been flying for a long time. Sometimes Curt must fly at night when there is no light in the sky.

slides.text: At night, everyone on the plane is asleep and it is silent. This is peaceful, but sometimes it gets boring. Curt prefers to fly in the daylight. This is when he can see the land below and talk to people.
